opening: I have itching around my vulva.
The itching and the pain during sex have been going on for a year.
I went through menopause 8 years ago, when I was 52.
I was sexually active with my husband until recently; we stopped because of the pain.

opening.text: I have itching around my vulva, and it's quite severe. Sex has also become painful, and both of these issues have gradually gotten worse over the past year. I went through menopause eight years ago when I was 52, and I have type 2 diabetes. I was sexually active with my husband until recently, but we stopped because of the pain.
